sops.title: Change / addition of bank account — offline (UTI MF form)
steps: Search "Form for change of bank account details" on Google and open Service Request Forms (UTI Mutual Fund).
Select "Service Request Forms" and category "Updation And Service Request", click Get Service Request Forms and open "Form for Change of Bank A/c Details".
Fill in the date, folio number, first holder's name and scheme name.
Fill in the old / existing bank details, the new bank details and the date of opening of the account.
Tick the documents provided, fill the holder's mobile and e-mail, and the PAN & Aadhaar number if they are to be updated in the folio.
Take the signature(s) of the holder(s); go through the form's guidelines and checklist (capital letters, signed as per holding, bank details legible, proofs attached).
Documents (self-attested): COB form, old / existing bank proof (cancelled cheque / passbook / statement / letter from bank), new bank proof and PAN card.
If there is a signature mismatch, bank attestation on Annexure 1A is needed — see the Annexure 1A SOP.
sops.reviewNote: Slide 7 is a filled change-of-bank form with a client's folio and name, and slides 13–15 a client's cheque, bank statement and PAN card — withheld.

sops.title: Change of bank account — online (MF Central)
steps: Sign in to MF Central with the client's PAN and password (with the client's permission) — tick "I'm not a robot" and Sign In.
Answer the security questions and Submit; read the note on folios and click OK.
Home › Service Requests — read the note (requests are accepted only for folios registered with MF Central) and click Proceed.
Choose Change of Bank Account Details.
Tick the scheme(s) whose bank account is to be changed and Submit.

Enter the new bank account number and IFSC (bank name and branch fill in), then upload the old bank's cancelled cheque, the new bank's cancelled cheque and the investor's signature (pdf / jpg / png, up to 2 MB each) — Submit.
Note the tracking reference number on the Success page; Track My Request shows each folio's status.
MF Central changes need the client's own ID and password: create them with the client's permission if the client has none.
sops.reviewNote: Slides 2, 8 and 11 show an investor's MF Central user ID (PAN), folio numbers, bank and IFSC — withheld. Slides 5, 7, 9 and 10 show investors' names.

sops.title: Change of default bank mandate — offline form
steps: Search "change of default bank mandate form" on Google and open the change of bank mandate forms.
Fill up the form: investor name, folio number(s), contact number and the new bank details (bank name, address, city & PIN).
Take the signature(s) as per the holding in the folio and mention the investor name & PAN.
If the signature does not match, get it attested by the bank manager / authorised official, with signature and stamp and their name, designation, employee code and phone number.
Attach a self-attested PAN copy.

Attach any one bank proof: cancelled original cheque of the new and the existing account (first holder's name printed), passbook / statement of the new and existing account (entries not older than 3 months), or a bank letter on letterhead.

Per the form's instructions: without existing-bank proof, a self-attested PAN copy can be given if PAN is registered; Savings → NRE or NRO → NRE change is not allowed; a 10-day cooling period applies to redemptions.
sops.reviewNote: Slides 9–11 are a client's cheque, bank statement and PAN card (covered only by shapes drawn on top, which a PDF does not truly hide) — withheld from the PDF.

sops.title: Change of e-mail ID — online (MF Central)
steps: Sign in to MF Central with the client's PAN and password (with the client's permission) — tick "I'm not a robot" and Sign In.
Answer the security questions and Submit; read the note on folios and click OK.
Home › Service Requests — read the note (requests are accepted only for folios registered with MF Central) and click Proceed.
Choose Change / Update Email Address.
Enter the new e-mail address and the e-mail relationship (e.g. Self, or Dependent Siblings) and Submit.
Tick the fund(s) / folio(s) in which the e-mail is to be changed and Submit.
Note the tracking reference number on the Success page; Track My Request shows each folio's status.
MF Central changes need the client's own ID and password: create them with the client's permission if the client has none.

sops.title: Change of guardian (minor's folio)
steps: Prepare a request letter for change of guardian.
Mention all the necessary data: the minor's name, folio number, and the existing and the requested guardian's names.
Take the signatures of both the existing and the requested guardian on the letter.

Documents: the signed request letter; the minor's proof of identity, signed by the requested guardian; proof of identity of both the existing and the requested guardian with their respective signatures.

sops.title: Change of mobile number / e-mail ID — offline (CAMS PAN-based form)
steps: Search "PAN based email id updation form" on Google and open the CAMS "PAN based Email Id / Mobile No. Updation Form".
Fill in the investor's (first / sole holder's) PAN and name.
Tick box 1 to update the contact details, or box 2 to update the declaration of the e-mail ID.
For the e-mail: tick the box, write the updated e-mail address and tick whom it belongs to (self, spouse, dependent etc.).
For the mobile: tick the box, write the updated mobile number and tick whom it belongs to.
Add office / residence phone numbers if any, tick the box to update KYC in all folios if needed, and take the unit holder(s)' signature(s).
Document required: self-attested PAN card.

sops.title: Change of mobile number — online (MF Central)
steps: Sign in to MF Central with the client's PAN and password (with the client's permission) — tick "I'm not a robot" and Sign In.
Answer the security questions and Submit; read the note on folios and click OK.

sops.title: Change of name — offline (SBI Mutual Fund form)
steps: Search "Name change request form" on Google and open the SBI Mutual Fund "Change of Name Request Form".
Enter the folio number(s) and tick the reason for the change (first name, middle name / surname, marriage, divorce, minor).
Write the old and new names of each unit holder; tick the change of tax status if required.
Fill the new bank account details: account number, type, bank, branch, city, PIN, MICR and IFSC.
Take the unit holder(s)' signatures, and get the signature attested by the bank: banker's name, designation, employee code and contact, with the bank's stamp.

Documents for a change of first name, middle name / surname, marriage or divorce: self-attested PAN and KYC confirmation in the new name; if the signature changes, the new signature attested by the bank manager with the bank seal.

Plus: first name — notarised gazette notification; middle name / surname — affidavit on ₹20 non-judicial stamp paper attested by a notary; marriage — marriage certificate verified by an SBI MF branch / notary; divorce — notarised court order.
Change in a minor's name: the form signed by the guardian, and the minor's attested birth certificate as proof of the new name.
For a tax-status change, attach one bank proof: cancelled cheque of the new and existing accounts, a recent passbook / statement, or a bank letter on its letterhead.
sops.reviewNote: Slides 11–14 are a client's signed PAN card, CAMS KRA record and notarised affidavit (covered only by shapes drawn on top) — withheld from the PDF.

sops.title: Consolidation of folios — offline form
steps: Search "Folio consolidation form" on Google, open the MF folio consolidation form and download it.
Fill in the AMC name and the investor name.
Write the target folio number (into which all other folios will be consolidated) and the other folio numbers to be consolidated into it.
Check the pattern of all folios is exactly the same: names of all unit holders, order and mode of holding, bank details, address, tax status, nominee details and IDCW option.
Fill the contact details that should appear in the target folio.
Mention the name & PAN of the holder(s) and take their signature(s); for a minor, specify the guardian's name.

sops.title: Consolidation of folios — online (CAMS Edge 360)
steps: Log in to CAMS Edge 360: enter the login details and captcha, click Next, fill the required data as mentioned and click Dashboard.

Check first: folios are consolidated only if PAN / names of all holders, order and mode of holding, bank details, address, tax status, nominee and IDCW option are identical; the target folio's holding, mandate, address and nomination prevail.
Click NFTs, then New Request.
Search the investor by PAN / name etc. and press Enter.
Click Consolidation of Folios, select the fund house / AMC and Continue.
Choose the investor's registered mobile no. and e-mail ID from the dropdown, then Proceed.
Select the target folio (the main folio into which all others are merged) and Continue.
Select the folios to be merged into the target folio, then Next.
Check all the details, ask the client for the reference number and press Confirm.

sops.title: Minor attains majority — status change (CAMS service request form)
steps: Search "Service request forms" on Google, open the service request forms and click Minor attains major.
Click Form No. 1, click Print and open the form.
Fill the applicant's name, DOB, PAN and AMC name; tick the tax status and the documents attached; mention the guardian's name and relationship with the applicant.
Mention the folio number(s) and the applicant's contact details, address and bank account details; tick the documents attached.
Tick the applicant's occupation and the other details after asking the applicant; mention country and place of birth and nationality.
Tick whether the applicant wants to add a nominee — if yes, fill and attach the nomination form.
Take the applicant's signature and mention the AMC name; mention the guardian's name and take the guardian's signature.

Documents: copy of the applicant's PAN; KYC acknowledgement or KYC form; cancelled cheque with the applicant's name pre-printed, or bank statement / passbook; Annexure-I (banker's attestation of signature); nomination form.
sops.reviewNote: Slides 17–21 are a client's PAN, KYC record, cheque, bank attestation and filled CAMS forms (covered only by shapes drawn on top, which a PDF does not truly hide) — withheld from the PDF.

sops.title: Nominee change / addition — online (CAMS Edge 360)
steps: Log in to CAMS Edge 360: enter the login details and captcha, click Next, fill the required data as mentioned and click Dashboard.
Click NFTs, then New Request.
Search the investor by PAN / name etc. and press Enter.
Click Update Nominee Details, then Continue.
Choose the investor's registered mobile no. and e-mail ID from the dropdown, then Proceed.
Tick the folio(s) in which the nominee is to be added or changed and press Continue.
Click Add New Nominee and fill the nominee's name, relationship, gender and date of birth.
Fill the nominee's mobile, e-mail, address and city, the % share, ID type and ID number; for more than one nominee click Add Nominee and fill the same details.
Click Next, check the filled details and click Enter Ref. No.
Ask the client for the reference number and press Confirm; "Update Nominee transaction is submitted successfully" appears.

sops.title: Nominee deletion / nomination opt-out — offline (CAMS form)
steps: Search "Nomination Opt Out / Deletion Form" on Google and open the CAMS Online nomination page.
Under Nomination Opt-in / Opt-out – Physical Form, click point 2, "Declaration form for opting out of nomination".
Click Print to download the form and open it.

Take the signature(s) of the holder(s).

sops.title: Nominee updation / addition (CAMS nomination form)
steps: Search "CAMS Nomination Form" on Google and open the nomination form.
Fill it in CAPITAL letters: fund house (e.g. HDFC Mutual Fund), folio number(s) — several folios can go in the same box — and the investor's name as per PAN.

Nominee details: each nominee's name (Mr / Ms), share (one nominee 100%; more than one — ask the client the percentage), date of birth (dd-mm-yyyy, as per proof of identity) and relationship with the applicant (tick the box).
Nominee identity: for a major, tick one ID type and give its number; for a minor, the guardian's. Address as per Aadhaar (a minor's guardian's), with PIN code.
Nominee's mobile and e-mail (a minor's guardian's); the guardian's name if the nominee is under 18.
Tick the boxes if the client wants the nominee's name and percentage printed on the statement of holding.
Take the client's signature(s) / thumb impression as per the mode of holding.
Documents: self-attested PAN and Aadhaar copies; do the OSV (original seen and verified).
sops.reviewNote: Slides 12–16 are a real client's filled nomination form, Aadhaar card and PAN card — withheld from the PDF.

sops.title: PAN update / correction
steps: Prepare a request letter to the respective AMC for updation / correction of the PAN.
In it, mention the investor's name, PAN and folio number(s) and the AMC's name; the investor signs it.
Attach a self-attested copy of the PAN card with the signed request letter.

sops.title: Signature attestation by bank — Annexure 1A (signature change / mismatch)
steps: Search "Annexure 1A form" on Google and click Annexure - 1 to get the form.
Fill in the date, the account holder's name and the bank name & branch.
Fill in the account number, type of account, MICR code and IFSC code.
Write the holder's address as per bank records with city, PIN code and state, and take the holder's signature: it must be clear and the bank stamp must not overlap it.
Get the bank official's signature and stamp (not overlapping the holder's signature) with their name, designation, employee code and contact number, which the official provides.
Documents: the holder's Aadhaar card and PAN card (self-attested, OSV — original seen and verified — done) and the holder's bank proof (self-attested).
Use this attestation for signature change / sign mismatch, bank change, transmission and minor-to-major cases.
sops.reviewNote: Slides 5–7 are a filled Annexure 1A with a client's bank account, IFSC, address and signature, and slides 10–12 a client's Aadhaar, PAN card and cheque — withheld.

sops.title: Transmission of units on death of the first holder — to surviving joint holder (Form T2)
steps: Search "T2 Form" on Google and open Form T2 — Request for Transmission of Units by Surviving Joint Holder/s (where the 1st holder is deceased).
Fill the date and the AMC name, then the scheme name, folio number and number of units (or all units).
Fill the surviving unit holder's name, PAN and tax status; holder 1's mobile / landline and e-mail, and tick whose contact details they are (self, spouse, sibling …).
Fill holder 1's updated address with city, state and PIN, and bank details: bank name, account number and type, IFSC, MICR, branch and city.
Tick the bank proof attached for validation — a bank statement must have the name and account number pre-printed and be stamped by the bank official.

Tick holder 1's occupation and gross annual income (confirm with the client); fill country and place of birth and nationality; tick 'No' if not a tax resident of any other country — if 'Yes', give the country, TIN and identification type.
Tick whether holder 1 does not wish to nominate or wants to nominate — for a nomination attach a separate nomination form.
Fill the fund house / AMC name and take the signatures of the new holder 1 and holder 2.
Tick the boxes for the documents attached.

Documents: T2 form; nominee updation form; death certificate (notarised); deceased holder's Aadhaar and PAN; claimant's PAN and Aadhaar (self-attested, OSV done); cheque copy; banker's attestation; KYC validation copy.
sops.reviewNote: Slides 16–21 are a real case's death certificate, Aadhaar, PAN, cheque, banker's attestation and KYC page — withheld.

sops.title: New policy proposal — Bajaj Life Partner Plus (DiGi Agency)
steps: Visit https://partnerplus.bajajlife.com/ and log in with user ID and password (or log in with OTP).
Click View All Plans and pick the plan (the deck uses a savings plan — GAIN).

On 'Let's get you onboarded faster', keep the pre-selected options (change them for an NRI), choose whether to opt for Account Aggregator benefits, enter mobile number, date of birth, PAN and name as per PAN, select Yes / No for NRI status and click Proceed.
KYC through Aadhaar: enter the Aadhaar number, enter the OTP and submit; verify the policy holder details fetched from Aadhaar and the address, then click Proceed.
Personal details: keep annual income and earned income the same, select occupation, industry type and company name, then the stage of life, life goal and investment strategy, and proceed.
Check the pre-approved offer / recommended product and document requirements, fill the other details and click Next.
Product information: policy term, premium paying term, frequency and premium amount; keep Sum Assured Factor as 10.
Choose the variant and fund strategy and the fund allocation; keep SPW as No (otherwise small amounts switch into the market automatically); uncheck all the riders.
View and download the instructions to verify, click Next, then Submit & Continue (mobile and e-mail), and Thank You & Proceed — note the application number.
Fill the proposal: life assured's personal details, education and occupation, permanent address, other details and premium payer, then click Submit.
Fill the nominee details and click Add Nominee; fill height and weight and the lifestyle questionnaire.
Verify all information, click Generate OTP and download the proposal form; enter the OTP and click Submit OTP.

Mandate registration: click Download Prefilled NACH, or select the authentication option (Aadhaar / net banking / debit card) and click Proceed to Register; for Aadhaar, enter the Aadhaar number and submit.

sops.title: Quotation / benefit illustration — Bajaj Life (eTouch II term plan)
steps: Open any browser and visit https://bi.bajajlife.com/SIS/Need.aspx.
Select Term & Health Plan and click Let's Go.
Enter the policy holder's date of birth, annual income and existing life cover, select the goal (e.g. Secure family's future) and click Next.
Click View All Products, then select the product (eTouch II).

Basic details: policy holder's first, middle and last name, gender and date of birth; set Life Assured Details 'Same as above' to Yes or No (if No, enter the life assured's details); then residence status, PIN code, proposer's state and sales person's state.

Product details: policy term (e.g. cover up to age 99), 'I will pay premium for' (years), premium frequency, existing customer, first-time buyer, premium holidays, plan variant and life benefit (lump sum / monthly instalments).
Fill medical / non-medical, smoker / tobacco, salaried, education, annual income and occupation; choose the % of lump sum and instalment years if monthly instalments are chosen.
Enter the sum assured.

Riders: Accidental Death Benefit and Accidental Permanent Total / Partial Disability Benefit sum assured; Family Protect Rider (e.g. Parental Care — enter the rider beneficiary's name, date of birth, gender and rider sum assured).

New Critical Illness Benefit Rider option (Comprehensive / Critical / Enhanced) with sum assured, and Care Plus Rider – Non Linked option (Prime / Pro / Ultra / Prestige / Optima) with its premium paying term (the deck shows each option's benefit table).
Click Generate BI to get the Bajaj Life eTouch II business illustration.

sops.title: Term insurance quotation — Bajaj Life eTouch II (BI generation)
steps: Open the quotation link (https://shorturl.at/XQh36) and choose the Term & Health Plan option.
Enter the policy holder's date of birth, annual income and existing life insurance cover (if any), then click Next Step.
Select the eTouch II plan.

Life assured details: if the life assured is the same person choose Yes; if not, enter the life assured's name, gender, DOB and age. Then residential status (RI / NRI) and PIN code; proposer's and sales person's state fill automatically.

Plan variant – Life Shield / Life Shield Plus / Life Shield ROP; ADB 100%; Life Benefit – lump sum payout; smoker / tobacco – Yes / No; Salaried – Yes; occupation.

Riders: Accidental Benefits / Accidental Permanent Total / Partial Disability benefit amount; New Critical Illness Benefit Rider (Comprehensive, Critical or Enhanced); Care Plus Rider – Non Linked (Prime, Pro, Ultra, Prestige or Optima).
Click Generate BI; when the report is generated, scroll down and click Download PDF.

sops.title: Company account opening (Anand Rathi)
steps: Log in to the Anand Rathi mailbox Finowise.ar@gmail.com and write to the Anand Rathi team.

Also: 3 years' ITR and 6 months' bank statement; list of directors (as on date, on company letterhead); directors' PAN copies and address proof (Aadhaar, passport).

sops.title: HUF account onboarding — NJ E-Wealth (physical) and scan mandate upload
steps: HUF is a non-individual client — onboarding is in physical mode only, with the NJ HUF account onboarding form.

Documents: E-Wealth / E-Wealth MF account opening form (HUF); PAN copy in the HUF's name; HUF deed of declaration with any supplemental deeds; annexure page with all co-parceners' details; POI / POA and PAN of the Karta.

Also: address proof in the applicant's name, not older than 3 months (bank statement, passbook, utility bill or rent agreement); bank proof in the applicant's name (cancelled cheque, statement or passbook).
On a name mismatch between the bank proof and PAN, add a bank-certified letter (stamped and signed) that both belong to the same entity.
If the HUF name and Karta name differ because the HUF-name person has died: death certificate and no-objection from the surviving HUF members.

Once the E-Wealth account is activated, submit the mandate through the scan mandate utility on the Partner Desk (mutual fund mandate in favour of NSCCL; other mandate in favour of NJ India Invest Pvt Ltd).
Log in to the NJ Partner Desk (partner ID, password, captcha) and go to Stock Exchange › Update Bank & Mandate Details.
Select UCC or Client Name (from the active E-Wealth clients) and click Submit; click Add Mandate, choose the existing registered bank and mode of holding, and click Add Mandate.
Set Mandate Segment (Mutual Fund & Other), Authorization Mode › Scan and the mandate upper limit; click Submit.
Click Print Physical Mandate to download / print it (it is also e-mailed to the partner); the client fills only name and signature as per bank records.
Upload the signed scan mandate (browse and select the correct mandate number) and click Submit — the status changes to Received at HO in 2–3 hours.
To upload later: Stock Exchange › Pending Scan Mandate, select the client (UCC / client name / ref no / PTRAX ref no), click Submit, upload against the pending entry and Submit.
Rules: thumb-impression mandates are not accepted (use e-mandate); several scan mandates can go for the same bank account / UCC; mandates not uploaded within 15 days are auto-rejected.

sops.title: HUF KYC — physical (CAMS KRA forms)
steps: Non-individual KYC form (front): tick the application type New / Update and fill the entity details as per the HUF PAN card.
Non-individual form (back): take the Karta's signature with the HUF stamp and fill the date and place; IPV is done by the branch head / authorised person.

Individual KYC form for the Karta (front): application type New, related person "Karta"; fill the personal details as per the Karta's PAN card and attach the Karta's photo with signature and HUF stamp.
Individual form (back): Karta's signature with HUF stamp, date and place; IPV by the branch head / authorised person.
Documents, each self-attested with OVD done by the branch head / authorised person: HUF PAN, HUF bank passbook, Karta's PAN card and Karta's Aadhaar card.

sops.title: AIF Category II onboarding — Piper Serica
sops.docNo: SOP Title : Piper Serica AIF Category 2- Onboarding
steps: Onboarding: risk profiling (RPQ), investor eligibility check and minimum investment confirmation.
Documents: PAN card, Aadhaar card, address proof, bank proof (cancelled cheque), FATCA declaration, AIF application form and commitment agreement.
Commitment: the investor signs the commitment agreement; define the capital commitment amount, explain the drawdown schedule and get the terms acknowledged.
Fund transfer: the capital call notice is issued, the investor transfers funds to the AIF account by RTGS / NEFT, and a confirmation receipt is generated.
Units are allotted after the funds are received; the allotment confirmation and statement of holding are shared.
Reporting: quarterly portfolio report, capital account statement, valuation updates, annual audit report and taxation statement.
Compliance: SEBI AIF regulations, lock-in as per scheme structure, exit strategy as per the PPM, performance fee (if any).
Roles: the investor gives accurate documents, transfers funds on time and reviews reports; the RM ensures KYC, explains risk and structure and coordinates with the AIF team.

sops.title: AIF Category II top-up / rebalancing — Piper Serica
steps: Top-up: the client confirms the additional amount; the RM reconfirms the scheme is open for subscription / drawdown.
Eligibility: check the minimum additional commitment (as per PPM), KYC validity and FATCA validity.
Documents if required: additional commitment form; updated risk profiling if compliance asks.
Capital call: share the bank details, confirm the payment timeline, and make sure funds come from the registered bank account.
Operations verify the UTR and the scheme mapping (no third-party transfer); units are allotted at the prevailing NAV / structure and the confirmation is issued.
Rebalancing: understand the reason (risk change / liquidity / strategy shift); in Category II, portfolio rebalancing is done by the fund manager and investor-level switching is generally restricted.
Check whether switching / partial exit is permitted and the lock-in and exit terms in the PPM; review exit load, capital-gains impact and regulatory restrictions.
Execute the redemption (if allowed) and a fresh commitment in the new strategy (if applicable); share the exit and new allotment confirmations.

Keep the client's written request (e-mail mandatory), UTR, updated commitment form and allotment / exit confirmation. Always check the latest PPM and that the window is open before promising timelines.

sops.title: AIF onboarding / account opening (Piper Serica)
steps: RM collects the client's details and documents: Aadhaar card, PAN card, nominee details, e-mail ID and mobile number, and a cancelled cheque (for bank details).

Do the eKYC and verification: OTP on the registered mobile, OTP on the registered e-mail, Aadhaar-based OTP authentication, live photo capture (assisted by the RM) and a verification call with the client.

Share the documents with the processing team (e.g. Piper Serica team), who verify them and handle the backend account opening; the RM makes sure the checklist is complete, documents are verified and client details are correct.
Complete the online Risk Profiling Questionnaire (RPQ): conducted by the RM, but the client must answer personally; it is the basis for the fund recommendation.
Investment activation: keep a minimum ₹5 lakh in a liquid fund (if applicable) and set up the new SIP in the selected fund; take the client's consent before fund allocation.
For an investment of ₹25 lakh or more, an initial commitment agreement is needed; the client's signature is mandatory.
Final confirmation: check the account is opened and the investment confirmation received, inform the client of the next steps, and keep proper records for audit.

sops.title: Angel fund investment — Piper Serica
steps: Pre-checks: investor qualifies as an angel investor (SEBI criteria), KYC done and verified, risk profiling done, PPM shared and acknowledged, minimum commitment confirmed; the Aadhaar copy must not be older than 8 days at submission.
Investment confirmation: the client confirms the amount in writing (e-mail mandatory); explain the lock-in and risk clearly.
Documents: angel investor declaration, commitment agreement, scheme application form, FATCA declaration and bank details confirmation.
Capital call: the fund issues the capital call notice; the RM informs the client and confirms the payment timeline.
Fund transfer by RTGS / NEFT from the registered bank account only; the UTR is shared with the RM.
Operations verify the amount received, the bank account match and the documents, and compliance clearance is obtained.
Units are allotted as per the scheme terms; the allotment confirmation and capital statement are shared with the investor.
Controls: strict eligibility check, no third-party payments, lock-in and exit restrictions communicated, start-up investment risk disclosed.
Keep: signed commitment agreement, angel investor declaration, UTR copy, allotment confirmation and the communication trail.

Intimation of Demise form: PMS account number, deceased holder's name, PAN and date of demise, and each notifier's (joint holder / nominee / legal heir) name, PAN, relationship, mobile, e-mail and address, with signatures.
DP Transmission Request Form (death of one / more joint holders): DP IDs and client IDs, deceased holder's name, surviving holders' names and signatures.
Account Closure Request Form and the DP's Intimation of Demise by joint holder(s) / nominee(s) form, signed by the surviving holders.

sops.title: Stock buy / sell transaction — Phillip Capital
steps: Pre-checks: active trading and demat account; enough ledger balance (buy) or holdings (sell); margin if applicable; written client confirmation received.
Take the client's trade instruction by e-mail or recorded line, confirming the stock name, buy / sell, quantity and order type (market / limit); reconfirm the price risk.
Forward the instruction to the Phillip Capital dealing team with the client code, stock details, quantity and order type; keep the mail trail and get the broker team's acknowledgement.
Phillip Capital executes the order as instructed; monitor the order status and receive the execution details.
Share the execution price and quantity and the trade status (executed / partial / pending) with the client, and tell them the contract note will follow.
After the trade: Phillip Capital issues the contract note; the ledger, demat holdings and margin are updated.
Compliance: written instruction mandatory, no unauthorised trades, no third-party fund transfers, keep the communication trail, explain market risk.
Keep records: client instruction e-mail, broker acknowledgement, contract note, trade confirmation, ledger copy and communication trail.

sops.title: Stocks advisory onboarding — Phillip Capital
steps: Open the account through eKYC; the RM collects and shares the supporting documents. Keep the client available for the whole process.
eKYC actions: OTP on SMS, OTP on e-mail, live photo capture (RM assists), Aadhaar-based OTP authentication and a verification call with the client.
Once the account is open, the RM conducts the online Risk Profiling Questionnaire (RPQ): 6–7 investment questions and 2 SMS OTP authentications. RPQ is mandatory before advisory activation.
The client selects ONE strategy: Equity Advisory, Impact, Oasis, Cosmos, Nautical or Ratnatrya; the RM explains the features first.
The client chooses the investment option: Lumpsum, Lumpsum + STP, or Lumpsum + SEP (systematic equity plan). eNACH is mandatory.
The client transfers funds to the Phillip Capital account (the RM shares the bank details); the RM confirms the credit before advisory generation.
Once funds are credited, the advisory is generated and e-mailed; the client approves it with OTP, or logs in to the P9 App and approves it.
The strategy holds equities plus a debt component (liquid funds); the client tracks holdings in the P9 App. Advisory fees are charged quarterly from the portfolio.
A month-end performance report is e-mailed every 10th of the month.
Compliance: correct strategy selection, RPQ before execution, keep OTP confirmation records and the e-mail trail for audit.
